question: How should the thirty-six-tattva trident be contemplated?
premises: All mantra wheels and effort are involved.
The trident is made of thirty-six tattvas.
inference: The verse instructs contemplating the thirty-six-tattva trident with mantra-wheel effort.
plain_english: With effort of all mantra wheels and so on, one should contemplate the trident made of thirty-six tattvas.
